20715b2697: integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Semi-realistic CG, a cyberpunk neon alley in the rain set against ancient wuxia: a young woman with her hair tied in a ponytail, dressed in white training clothes, a long staff in her hands, stands in a standoff with a tall heavy-armoured mech in full heavy armour;
a70d2d5c0c: The two stand several metres apart on the wet paving of the street, the mech nearer at the right of frame and the woman farther at the left of frame.
c503445e98: The pause is very short; the mech immediately uses his arms to push clear the bricks pressing down on him, the bricks rolling down off the armour, he props his upper body up and then stands to his feet;
418ac1fdeb: Once the camera has come around, that woman is standing at the other end of the alley — the long staff held level in both her hands, squarely facing him;
3689ec6d83: The camera holds static and takes both figures into frame: the mech holds the nearer right of frame with his back to the camera, the woman stands farther at the left of frame facing him head-on, the two squared up facing each other several metres apart, and neither one moves.
4f933fe3d9: Camera: opens on a side medium shot, then pans with large amplitude toward directly behind him along the axis he is swept out on and tracks him out, finally settling on the brick wall he has crashed down;
aea3c97922: The camera then tilts up at slow speed as he props his upper body up and stands, arcs in close along the direction of his turn to his side and leads forward, then settles steady at the end of the move with the mech and that woman both taken into frame, the mech nearer at the right of frame and the woman farther at the left of frame. The move is continuous and never cuts. Motion: every movement in this shot flows into the next without pause, freeze, hesitation or abrupt jump — the wind-up, the swing, the launch, the long flight, the impact, the rise and the turn are one unbroken motion, no gap between moves. The direction of his flight is the straight continuation of the swing that hit him: he travels away from her along the line the staff swept through, not sideways and not toward the camera. Keep unchanged throughout: The long staff in the woman's hands: a slender matte dark shaft marked with a few shallow old scuffs, as thick as her wrist;
992478fd0f: The mech is in full heavy armour and of tall build; the form and position of the red light strips on his armour stay unchanged throughout.
a65c2542c6: The bricks, mortar, dust haze, debris, sparks, water splash, standing water and crates in the environment, along with the hair and hem whipped about, are passive displacement, not extraneous movement.
f1163e70b3: overall_soundscape: the scrape of the rear foot driving off the ground, a long whoop of the shaft sweeping through the air, one heavy dull thud of the hit, the rush of armour leaving the ground, the run of cracking as the brick wall comes down, the breaking sound of bricks being pushed clear and rolling down, the metal friction as the armour rises and turns, mortar falling to the ground, rain, and the low electrical hum of neon in the distance. Diegetic sound only, synchronised to the picture.

781010dec2: Directly behind her is the metal roller shutter running horizontally at the left of frame, and farther back is the depth of the street with its neon-lit shop signs.
0a3f9e24fe: Landscape 16:9 cinematic composition with deep blocking across the wide frame, cinematic voluminal light and shallow depth of field, humid sticky air, holographic cold light leaking down and warm orange neon reflected on black wet paving and rusted pipes, an oily sour fog;
e03f805ee8: One continuous take, no cut inside this shot; the opening composition, environment, subject positions, clothing, carried objects and lighting are exactly as shown in <Picture 1>, and no identity or location changes mid-shot. ca5f62a823: He charges straight in to right before her and a close-range fist slams into her body: at the point where the fist meets her body a burst of blown-out white light opens, the standing water on the ground is thrown up into spray, sparks and debris scatter sideways from the contact point.

658a97135b: She slams hard into the horizontal metal roller shutter directly behind her, the shutter caving inward in a wide dent, the mortar and standing water on its face bursting open together;
f58930c427: She slides down the face of the shutter to the ground and comes to rest seated, the long staff falling down beside her hands.
f57d80dfcf: Camera: the opening framing holds the two-person same-frame positions of the previous shot's closing frame, pushes in with small amplitude as the mech lowers his body and drives off, then tracks along the direction he charges, shortening the distance to him; after the hit the camera follows her out toward the left of frame along the direction she travels, and finally settles on the roller shutter she crashes into, with her seated in front of the shutter in the closing frame and the mech left at the side-behind on the right of frame.
